My usual vet was closed, and although I knew this place had a bad reputation, my dog's nose was only slightly dry and flaky, so I figured I'd have to try it since it was nearby. I went in, and...
The vet calmly trimmed the hair on my dog's nose, scrubbed it roughly, and it turned bright red. Despite the examination, the woman, who looked to be around 70, had a creepy aura and gave a long, drawn-out explanation typical of someone her age, listing several possibilities (even cancer). Finally, she asked, "How far can you treat it?" which truly surprised me. (laughs)
She said she thought it was fleas and told me to come back every month, but I wasn't convinced.
The next day, I took my dog ​​to my regular vet, where they diagnosed it as keratosis and gave me an ointment, which cured it in three days.
In the dog community of younger people around here, we all share information, but I was surprised by many things, so I shared this through word of mouth and within the community.
Their desperate desire to keep their dog coming back was quite something.
When I took my pet to the vet, it was put in a bag and restrained even though it wasn't struggling. The way it was handled felt rough, and I didn't feel comfortable entrusting my pet to them.

I've been a patient here for about two years.
Both the female and male veterinarians are incredibly kind, understanding each dog's personality and providing warm, accurate examinations.
I'm surprised to see any negative reviews.

I made an appointment to take my cat for a health checkup.

I was told there was no one else there, so I was attended to by an elderly male doctor.

From the very beginning, he said things like he wasn't used to it and was having trouble because there was no one else.

My cat is usually calm, but when he tried to draw blood, he failed about 4 or 5 times, breaking the needle, and my cat thrashed around more than I'd ever seen her before, probably because it hurt.

He asked me to help hold her down because he wasn't used to drawing blood, which I did, but then he said something like, "You're not holding her down properly..." From beginning to end, I was just confused!

I couldn't understand why they only had someone who couldn't handle it alone, even though I had an appointment.

This is an unreliable hospital.

I felt so sorry for my cat.

Before that, on my first visit, a female doctor attended to me, but she was curt and unpleasant.

I should have realized then and gone to a different hospital.

But the reviews are pretty good, aren't they?

I can't help but think they might be changing their approach depending on the person they're dealing with.

The receptionist was polite and pleasant.

I visit this veterinary clinic regularly, and I highly recommend it to other cat owners.

My cat is easily frightened and prone to anxiety, so I always feel worried when taking her to the vet.

However, I never feel that way at this clinic.

The woman who answered the phone (a nurse?) was very pleasant, and I felt at ease even before going.

The female and male doctors are also very kind and create a warm, homey atmosphere, making the clinic feel less stressful and allowing me to entrust my cat to them with peace of mind.

When examining the cat, they don't just hold her with a towel or something similar; they also put her in a bag, which is reassuring.

They speak to the cat and handle her gently from the moment they take her out of the carrier, so I think it's a truly kind and considerate clinic.

The veterinarian is very kind.

I've never been to an animal hospital myself, so I can't compare it to others, but unlike the affiliated shops that come with pet stores, the prices are the same or even cheaper, and it's reassuring to have one nearby.

They accept major insurance plans, and the out-of-pocket payment is the amount after insurance is deducted, so it's easy on the wallet.
It's very convenient as it's open on weekends and the teachers are very kind.

I took my toy poodle in for treatment for periodontal disease. It was in a very bad state, but they treated him very kindly, and I regret not going sooner. I hadn't been able to take him for grooming either, but they cleaned him up nicely and were very kind. I would definitely use their services again.
I am very grateful for your consistently kind assistance. Since you are open on weekends as well, I appreciate being able to consult with you anytime I have a problem.

This is a very warm and trustworthy hospital.

My cat was diagnosed with cancer, and another hospital on the same street strongly recommended immediate hospitalization and chemotherapy. However, I declined because I didn't want her to be stressed by hospitalization and wanted to spend the rest of her life with her at home. Instead, I went to this animal hospital. It was my first visit, but they listened carefully to my concerns, understood the situation, and provided palliative care, watching over her until the very end. I'm so glad I found such a wonderful doctor.
Even though I requested a sudden appointment, the doctor was very kind and polite. He is a kind doctor who can be relied upon when you are in trouble.

My cat had been having recurring nosebleeds, so I took her in for an examination.
I've also taken her in for other symptoms in the past, and the doctor and nurses are all very kind and helpful.
They explained everything clearly and thoroughly, which put me at ease.
I was so grateful that they were able to see her the same day I called in the morning. Her symptoms improved quickly, and they even asked about the symptoms she'd had treated in the past. I'd like to continue using their services in the future! Thank you so much!
